resources.string: No subscription at this link (error %1$d). Check the link or ask your provider
Access denied (error %1$d). The subscription may be disabled — ask your provider
Too many requests (error %1$d). Try again in a few minutes
The subscription server is down (error %1$d). Try again later
“%1$s” is valid until %2$s. Renew it to keep the VPN working.
“%1$s”: %2$s of %3$s left. Renew or top up to keep the VPN working.
The subscription is too large (over 16 MB). Tell your provider
A rule or node list in the subscription is too large (over 64 MB). Tell your provider
Couldn’t download the subscription. Check your connection and try again
The subscription link keeps redirecting to other addresses. Tell your provider
The link must start with https://
This is neither a subscription link nor a list of nodes. Paste the link from your provider
The subscription has no nodes. Tell your provider
The link returned something other than a subscription, or its config has an error. Check the link or tell your provider
The provider requires a device ID
This subscription isn’t available on this device
The subscription config didn’t load. Update the subscription; if that doesn’t help, tell your provider
The VPN keeps running on the previous settings. Check your rules and config edits
No subscription selected. Open ducker and choose one
Android didn’t let the VPN start. Turn it on with the button in the app; if that doesn’t help, check in settings whether another VPN is set as always-on
An error in ducker turned the VPN off. Connect again
Your phone closed ducker in the background. Connect again and check “Background work”
Your phone is out of storage. Free up some space — your subscriptions and settings are safe
A web page came instead of the subscription: the site may be blocked, or the link leads elsewhere. Try again later or check the link
The subscription is encrypted and needs the key from your provider. If a key is already entered, it does not fit
%1$s. The provider’s backup addresses (%2$d) didn’t answer either
